svg.desc: Tweet-sized quality snapshot for Fernly, a plant-care reminder app. Hero stat: zero — the number of times reminder delivery, the suspected cause of the dead plants that fill the angry app-store reviews, has ever been measured. Household sync is also unmeasurable today, photo-backup restore has never been rehearsed, while schedule math is proven by a property-test suite. First move: build the missing measurement.

svg.text: FERNLY · A PLANT-CARE APP · WHAT WE CAN PROVE TODAY
Fernly reminds people to water their plants. Of the one-star reviews that say anything,
dead plants dominate — and the most-named cause is a reminder that never arrived.
